rationale: Extenet and ExteNet Systems are one active U.S. digital-infrastructure platform. The latest regulatory cap table supports 42% Stonepeak, 32% KH Killington and 26% aggregated Other Members, and Pilot's 2026 transaction was only a partial Enterprise Fiber divestiture. The duplicate identity decision is clear, but Northleaf's current direct-versus-indirect route and the legal bridge from JH Killington to KH Killington remain undocumented, so the ownership after-image requires review before application.
recommendedChanges: Merge the duplicate Extenet and ExteNet Systems identities into one canonical Extenet (formerly ExteNet Systems) company.
Use ExteNet Systems, LLC as the current legal name and preserve Extenet, ExteNet Systems and ExteNet Systems, Inc. as aliases.
Represent the current direct cap table as 42% Stonepeak, 32% KH Killington and 26% Other Members; do not add DigitalBridge or Northleaf percentages to that 100% table.
Preserve DigitalBridge as a below-20% manager attribution within Other Members only to the extent supported by current regulatory evidence.
Treat Northleaf as a review item until its current vehicle, route and any disposition are resolved; do not infer an additive stake.
Correct the 2015 legal close to November 13 and record the August 15, 2026 Pilot Fiber transaction as a partial Enterprise Fiber divestiture, not a platform exit.
Keep ExteNet LVS and other affiliates beneath the manager-level company.
unresolvedQuestions: The legal instrument bridging JH Killington Communications, LLC to current holder KH Killington Communications, LLC is not publicly disclosed.
Northleaf's current vehicle, direct-versus-indirect route, stake and any post-index disposition remain unresolved.
The identities and stakes of the remaining Other Members are not publicly disclosed.
blockingReason: The duplicate merge is established, but Northleaf's current ownership disposition and the JH-to-KH legal bridge must be resolved or explicitly accepted as exceptions before a production ownership after-image can be generated.
